🚨Important Note On #HMPvirus. 

HMPV is not a deadly virus.
Most people get #HMPV before they turn 5.

symptoms:

Cough.
Fever.
Runny or stuffy nose.
Sore throat.
Wheezing.
Shortness of breath (dyspnea).
Rash. https://t.co/3RPVCoXnEf https://t.co/k7cpTuZCGY
